Thank you for getting in touch.

You asked if missing original packaging for your kettle means you are completely barred from returning it under your Extended Care plan. Our Returns and refunds policy, section "Extended Care: Returns under the plan", says missing original packaging does not automatically prevent a return. You should contact us first so we can explain whether suitable replacement packaging is required and whether we can assist you in arranging it.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You asked about the best way to keep your fridge temperature steady after finishing your groceries. Our help article "Energy saving settings for your Vale fridge freezer" says to maintain a steady temperature, keep door openings brief, ensure both doors close fully, and avoid blocking the internal air vents with food or packaging.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked about the E-6779 code on your Corra hob and whether you should be concerned about the internal electronics. Our help article "Corra induction hob heating slowly" says the E-6779 code indicates that restricted cooling airflow has triggered the hob's protective power limit. The appliance reduces its heat output in this scenario to prevent the internal electronics from overheating.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked if overfilling your Brio kettle causes water underneath the kettle. Our help article "Brio kettle leaking underneath" says filling above the MAX mark can cause water to spill. You should always ensure the water level is kept below this line.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked about the E-3496 error code on your Halvard Home Orrin heat pump and how to fix it. Our help article "Timer or delay start will not run" says the E-3496 code indicates your internal clock has lost its setting, often due to a power cut. You can restore the timer by opening the Settings menu, setting the current time, saving it, and then cancelling and re-entering your timed start.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked how to order a replacement side brush for your KX-3542 model vacuum. Our help article "Ordering a spare Mira side brush" says to order a replacement side brush for the KX-3542 Mira robot vacuum, contact Halvard Home customer support and quote that part number. Provide your delivery address and ask support to confirm the price and availability before you make a payment.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked if your two-year warranty covers internal faults in your Fenwick cooker hood or if you have invalidated it by performing maintenance work. Our help article "Fenwick cooker hood warranty" says your warranty covers faults caused by defective materials or workmanship. It does not cover routine maintenance like cleaning grease filters. If your cooker hood has developed a fault, please contact Halvard Home customer support with your proof of purchase.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked about the correct procedure for cleaning the filter in your Orrin heat pump and the frequency and conditions for washing it. Our help article "Cleaning your Orrin heat pump filter" says you should check the filter once a month, or more often if you have pets or a dusty home. Do not wash the filter unless it is marked as washable. Otherwise, use a vacuum cleaner with a soft brush attachment to remove dust.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked for the specific part number to order a replacement lower basket wheel for your Tessa dishwasher. Our help article "Replacing a lower basket wheel" says the replacement lower basket wheel kit for your Tessa dishwasher is KX-6373. You can order this kit directly from Halvard Home support.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked for steps to ensure your heating system remains serviced correctly after moving into a new home with an Orrin heat pump. Our Servicing and engineer visits policy, section "Orrin heat pump: Servicing schedule", says you should contact Halvard Home for assistance. We will review the available information and advise you on how to arrange a service without requiring you to estimate the installation date.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked if it is okay to take the casing apart of your Mira vacuum after noticing a burning smell. Our help article "Burning smell from your Mira robot vacuum" says you must not dismantle the battery or open the casing. Please only remove loose material from the brush and wheels that you can reach without opening the casing. It also says you must not dismantle the battery or open the casing. Please only remove loose material from the brush and wheels that you can reach without opening the casing, and contact Halvard Home support before using the vacuum again.

You have asked if you will be penalised for using a different box for your Mira robot vacuum. Our Returns and refunds policy, section "Mira robot vacuum: Packaging and condition", says you will not be penalised. However, you must use a strong box with suitable cushioning so the appliance sits securely without moving. Avoid using loose packing materials that could enter openings. You may contact Halvard Home if you are unsure if your packaging is suitable.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You asked if you could use your smart plug to schedule the Brio kettle to boil while you are asleep. Our help article "Brio kettle: timer and delay start" says you should not use a smart plug or a plug-in timer with the Brio kettle. Doing so could cause the kettle to be switched on unexpectedly or without enough water.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked for clarification regarding the handling charge for replacement parts fitted outside of your warranty. Our Servicing and engineer visits policy, section "Charges", says parts fitted outside the warranty carry a handling charge of 28%, which is calculated based on the price of the replacement parts rather than on labour or attendance charges.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked about the timeframe for requesting a colour exchange for your Brio kettle and any relevant details regarding the process. Our Returns and refunds policy, section "Brio kettle: Returning the appliance", says you must request a colour exchange within 54 days. Please contact our customer care team to discuss your preferred colour, noting that exchanges are subject to stock availability.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked for advice on how to repair the lid locking clip on your Brio kettle because you are experiencing an E-6736 error code. Our help article "Ordering a spare Brio kettle lid" says you should not attempt to repair the clip with glue. If the clip is cracked or broken, you must order a replacement lid by contacting Halvard Home customer support with your kettle's model name and serial number.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked about the E-6067 code on your Tessa dishwasher and what to do if the warning returns after you have descaled the machine. Our help article "Descaling your Tessa dishwasher" says the E-6067 code means limescale is restricting water flow through the heater, causing it to take too long to reach the wash temperature. If the warning returns after you have descaled the machine, you must stop using the dishwasher and contact Halvard Home support for an inspection.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked for the specific temperatures to check in each compartment of your Vale fridge freezer when you encounter an error message. Our help article "Fault message on your Vale fridge freezer" says you should check that your fridge is at 5°C or below and your freezer is at −18°C.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have noticed that your Ashby tumble dryer continues to heat even when your washing seems completely dry. Our help article "Saving energy with your Ashby tumble dryer" says a faulty KX-0711 sensor can cause your dryer to keep heating after the load is dry. You should stop the dryer, switch it off at the socket, and contact Halvard Home support to arrange a sensor check.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked if you should fix the E-1107 error on your Corra hob yourself or call Halvard Home. Our help article "Strange noises from your Corra induction hob" says you should stop cooking, switch the hob off at the wall isolator for at least 10 minutes, and check that the ventilation openings are clear of debris. If the noise or warning returns after restoring power, stop using the hob and contact Halvard Home support.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked how long you should expect to wait for a response regarding a safety issue with your Halvard Home tumble dryer after reporting it through our website. Our Safety and recalls policy, section "Reporting a safety concern", says safety reports are answered within 27 hours. This initial response will confirm receipt of your concern and outline the next available steps.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked about the charges for an inspection concluding that your dishwasher was caused by misuse. Our Warranty policy, section "What the warranty does not cover", says an inspection that finds misuse is charged at £106.00. We explain the inspection arrangements and any applicable charge before you agree to a visit.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked for advice regarding the steps needed to ensure you receive the correct replacement part for your Keel washing machine due to a small split in the door seal. Our help article "Replacing a Keel door seal" says you should contact Halvard Home support with your machine’s model details and a clear photo of the damage. Once you have provided this information, you should ask them to confirm that the replacement seal fits your machine before ordering.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked about the E-8255 error on your Lumen screen and how to resolve it while you are away from home. Our help article "Using your Lumen thermostat in a holiday home" says the E-8255 error indicates that your holiday schedule lacks a return date, preventing holiday mode from starting. To fix this, open the thermostat menu, select Holiday, and enter your return date, time, and preferred temperature before selecting Save.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You asked if a factory reset on your Orrin heat pump will remove your saved heating schedules and temperature preferences. Our help article "Resetting your Orrin heat pump" says that a factory reset will remove your saved heating schedules and temperature preferences. Please note these details down before you begin the reset process.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked for information regarding what details to provide when ordering a replacement part for your Keel washing machine. Our help article "Ordering a spare accessory" says that to order a spare accessory, please contact Halvard Home customer support with your appliance’s model details and a description of the accessory. You should also include a clear photo of the appliance’s identification label and, if you still have it, a photo of the original accessory to ensure compatibility.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked if your Orrin heat pump radiators feel cool compared to your old boiler and if this is normal behavior. Our help article "Orrin heat pump heating slowly" says your Orrin heat pump warms your home gradually, so radiators may feel cooler than those connected to a boiler. This does not necessarily mean there is a fault.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have noticed a rattling sound coming from your Orrin heat pump and asked what you should do first. Our help article "# Strange noises from your Orrin heat pump" says you should switch the heat pump off using its normal controls and check around the outdoor unit for any loose objects touching the casing. Once the area is clear, you may restart the unit, but you must not remove panels or reach through the grille.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked about the expected duration for which spare parts for your Fenwick cooker hood remain available after the model stops being sold. Our Servicing and engineer visits policy, section "Fenwick cooker hood: Common repairs", says spare parts for the Fenwick cooker hood are stocked for 8 years after the model is discontinued.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked how long you need to let your Brio kettle sit before you can fill it again after a warning light appears. Our help article "Brio kettle: flashing warning light" says you should leave the kettle to cool for at least 15 minutes before checking it.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked for advice on removing ice from your Vale fridge freezer without damaging the appliance. Our help article "Frost or condensation in your Vale fridge freezer" says you should unplug the appliance and move your food to suitable cold storage before defrosting. It also states that you should never use sharp tools or a hairdryer to remove the ice.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked if you should unscrew the hinges of your Corra induction hob to realign them while your lid is not closing. Our help article "Corra induction hob lid will not close" says you must not adjust the hinges yourself. If the warning returns or the lid remains stuck after you have cleaned the surface and checked for obstructions, please contact Halvard Home support.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You asked if you can run a wash cycle while the Keel firmware is updating. Our help article "Updating your Keel washing machine firmware" says you cannot start a wash programme while the installation is in progress.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked about the E-7084 error code on your Vale fridge freezer and the steps to take before contacting support. Our help article "Vale fridge freezer: unusual vibration" says the E-7084 code indicates that the vibration sensor has detected excessive movement, likely due to an uneven position or contact with nearby furniture. To resolve this, ensure the unit is level, not touching walls or cupboards, and that internal items are secure before unplugging it for five minutes to reset.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked if you should clean the grease filters of your Fenwick cooker hood before calling a professional for a burning smell. Our help article "Burning smell from your Fenwick cooker hood" says that once the hood has completely cooled, you may clean the removable grease filters according to the user guide. It also states that grease build-up can contribute to overheating. However, you must keep the hood switched off until a qualified service engineer has inspected it. You should not attempt to remove electrical covers or repair the motor.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked what you should look for regarding water pooling under your Vale fridge freezer. Our help article "Water leaking underneath your Vale fridge freezer" says water underneath your appliance can be caused by a spill, a blocked defrost drain, or a door that is not closing properly. You should check that food packaging is not preventing the doors from closing, clean the door seals, and clear any loose debris from the drain hole inside the fridge.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked for steps to take regarding a puddle under your KX-3928 washing machine while it is draining. Our help article "Booking a Keel engineer visit" says you should stop using the machine, switch it off, and close the water supply tap. You must unplug the machine only if the plug and surrounding area are dry and safe to reach. You must also ensure you do not attempt to remove panels or seal the leak yourself.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You asked for the part number for a replacement mounting backplate for your Lumen thermostat and what to do if the clip is cracked. Our help article "Moving your Lumen smart thermostat" says the replacement mounting backplate for the thermostat is the KX-6505. If a clip is cracked, do not tape the unit in place. Instead, arrange for the backplate to be replaced before restoring power.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You asked if you should pull your Corra hob out of the worktop after disconnecting the power. Our help article "Moving your Corra induction hob" says you must ask your installer to release any fixings or seals first. It also states that you must not lift the hob while it is still secured to the worktop.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked when to enter your Lumen thermostat schedule to delay your heating by an hour starting at 18:00. Our help article "Setting a delayed start on your Lumen thermostat" says that to set a one-hour delay starting at 18:00, you should set the start time to 19:00.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked if it is safe to open the battery compartment of your Mira vacuum to attempt to fix the issue of code E-9454 and the vacuum not starting. Our help article "Mira robot vacuum not switching on" says you must not open the battery compartment or attempt to bypass the protection system. If the vacuum does not switch on after three hours of charging, please contact Halvard Home support.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked how to restore the auto-off timer on your Fenwick cooker hood because the display shows E-9590. Our help article "Energy-saving settings" says to restore the timer, stop the fan, open Settings, and select Energy saving. Switch Auto-off to On and choose 10 minutes, which will cause the hood to stop the fan 10 minutes after you activate the run-on function.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked about the expected wait time for an engineer to come out for an electrical fault with your oven. Our Safety and recalls policy, section "Extended Care: Safety checks under the plan", says that as an Extended Care member reporting a safety concern, you will have an engineer attend within 7 hours of reporting the issue to us.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked about the provision of a loan machine if a repair to your Mira robot vacuum takes longer than 30 working days. Our Warranty policy, section "Mira robot vacuum: Repairs under warranty", says that if a repair to the Mira robot vacuum takes longer than 30 working days, Halvard Home will provide a loan replacement.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked about the last servicing date for your Fenwick cooker hood and the next due date. Our Servicing and engineer visits policy, section "Fenwick cooker hood: Servicing schedule", says you should contact Halvard Home to have us check the recorded service history for your cooker hood. We may ask you for evidence of installation or previous servicing to confirm the correct due date.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked if you should replace the internal KX-3100 power switch module yourself for your Keel washing machine. Our help article "Keel washing machine not switching on" says you should not attempt to remove the casing or replace the module yourself. If the socket works but the machine remains off, please unplug it and contact Halvard Home support to arrange an inspection.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You asked if you can use an extension lead after your Tessa dishwasher display briefly showed E-1736 and went completely blank. Our help article "Tessa dishwasher not switching on" says you must not use an extension lead. You should reconnect the dishwasher directly to the wall socket after following the 10-minute reset procedure.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked about the amount required to pay for a claim under your Extended Care Plus plan. Our Warranty policy, section "Extended Care Plus: What the plan adds", says each claim under the Extended Care Plus plan carries an excess of £90.00.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You asked if you should open your Orrin heat pump screen to check if the power module is loose. Our help article "Orrin heat pump display stays blank" says you must not remove the casing yourself. If the display remains blank after a restart, you must contact Halvard Home support to arrange an inspection.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked if you should continue using your Ashby tumble dryer after noticing a small tear in the mesh of your lint filter. Our help article "Replacing a damaged lint filter" says you should stop using the dryer until the damaged filter has been replaced with the KX-3639 part. This is because lint can otherwise pass into the dryer's airflow system.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You asked if you should remove your Lumen thermostat to access the filter while cleaning it. Our help article "Cleaning your heating or cooling filter" says you do not need to touch the thermostat to clean the filter. The filter is located in your heating or cooling equipment, not inside the Lumen thermostat.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked about the expected arrival time for an urgent safety visit for your appliance in Belfast and the maximum waiting time for a recall. Our Safety and recalls policy, section "Northern Ireland: Safety visits in this region", says that for urgent safety visits in Northern Ireland, Halvard Home aims to attend within 21 hours. If your appliance is included in a recall, the collection will be made within 46 working days.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Our help article "Recycling your old Corra induction hob" says you should ask the retailer if they offer an old-appliance collection service. Before booking this, make sure to confirm any associated charges and their specific requirements for disconnection.

Kind regards,

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked about the Ashby dryer issue where the tank says the tank is full even though it is bone dry. Our help article "Descaling your Ashby tumble dryer" says the issue is likely caused by limescale on the KX-3673 filter, which is located inside the water collection tank. You should inspect the filter for a white, chalky coating and descale it if necessary.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked if it is safe to try and glue the cracked retaining clip on the filter back together. Our help article "Replacing the Brio kettle’s filter" says you should not try to glue the clip. If the filter's retaining clip is damaged, you must replace the complete filter instead.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You asked if you need another person to move your Ashby tumble dryer by yourself. Our help article "Moving your Ashby tumble dryer" says you must use two people and a suitable appliance trolley to move the dryer. You should also ensure the unit is kept upright and never lifted by the door or control panel.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You asked how to fix the connection issue with your voice assistant after restarting your router because your Brio kettle is not found. Our help article "Pairing your Brio kettle with a voice assistant" says you should connect your phone to your 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network. Hold the kettle's pairing button for five seconds until the wireless light flashes. Then, re-add the kettle in the Halvard Home app. Finally, select your assistant in the Voice assistants menu and follow the linking instructions.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked if you must use the original packaging for your Corra induction hob or if you can send it back in something else. Our Returns and refunds policy, section "Corra induction hob: Packaging and condition", says that if you no longer have the original packaging, you should contact Halvard Home to discuss suitable alternatives for safe transport. It also states that missing the original packaging does not prevent you from exercising your legal rights when the hob is faulty or not as described.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked if you should use a descaling product on your Lumen smart thermostat to address limescale build-up near your heating controls. Our help article "Cleaning your Lumen smart thermostat" says that your Lumen smart thermostat does not need descaling. Descaling products are intended for water-handling equipment, and you should not use them, vinegar, or abrasive cleaners on your thermostat.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked about the duration of coverage for your Corra induction hob and the details of the warranty. Our help article "Corra induction hob warranty" says your warranty runs for two years, until 10 June 2028. It covers faults resulting from defective materials or workmanship during normal household use.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked for guidance regarding the photographs required to order a replacement door tray for your Vale fridge freezer. Our help article "Ordering a spare accessory for your Vale fridge freezer" says you should provide one clear photo of the accessory and one photo of the space where it fits. If the accessory is missing, you should photograph the empty space instead.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

You have asked for steps to resolve an E-1216 error on your Fenwick hood. Our help article "Fan speed signal fault" says to reset the hood, turn it off using the controls, switch off the power at the wall for five minutes, then restore the power and select the lowest fan setting. If the message clears and the fan runs normally, the unit is ready for use.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked what you should avoid when trying to fix your Fenwick cooker hood door not closing properly. Our help article "Fenwick cooker hood door or lid not closing" says that when attempting to close the door, please do so gently and do not force it, bend the hinges, or adjust the latch with tools.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked when you are entitled to a replacement appliance while waiting for a repair on your Tessa dishwasher. Our Warranty policy, section "Tessa dishwasher: Repairs under warranty", says that if a warranty repair to your Tessa dishwasher takes longer than 27 working days, Halvard Home will lend you a replacement appliance.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You asked if you should reset your Fenwick cooker hood and how long to leave it switched off at the wall. Our help article "Fenwick cooker hood not switching on" says you should switch the power off at the wall for 60 seconds before switching it back on and trying the fan control again.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked about the distance required between your new Vale fridge freezer and your gas hob, as well as the specific rules regarding ventilation openings. Our Safety and recalls policy, section "Vale fridge freezer: Installation and moving", says the appliance must be installed at least 118 centimetres away from a gas hob or open flame. Additionally, you must keep the ventilation openings clear and not cover them with packaging, furniture, curtains or stored items.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked what happens when you send a faulty appliance back to us for testing. Our Returns and refunds policy, section "Faulty appliances", says your appliance will be tested within 11 working days of its arrival to assess the reported fault and understand its cause. We will then explain the outcome of our assessment in plain language.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.

You have asked if you can dismantle your old Orrin heat pump yourself and put it in your household recycling bin. Our help article "Recycling your old Orrin heat pump" says you must not dismantle the unit yourself or put it in your household recycling bin. You should arrange for a qualified installer to disconnect the unit and safely recover the refrigerant, then use a licensed waste carrier or your local council to recycle it.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team

Thank you for getting in touch.
